title: Metformin activates AMPK and may modulate PCOS pathophysiology
abstract: Metformin, a first-line treatment for type 2 diabetes, has been shown to activate AMPK signaling. Recent studies suggest AMPK activation may play a role in regulating ovarian follicle development, implicating this pathway in polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) pathophysiology.

title: Rapamycin inhibits mTOR and extends lifespan in model organisms
abstract: Rapamycin is a well-characterized inhibitor of the mTOR pathway. mTOR signaling has been implicated in multiple age-related diseases, including neurodegenerative conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, where dysregulated mTOR activity affects autophagy and protein clearance.

title: Statins and their effect on inflammatory pathways
abstract: Statins, primarily prescribed for hyperlipidemia, are known to inhibit HMG-CoA reductase. Emerging evidence suggests statins also reduce systemic inflammation via effects on NF-kB signaling, a pathway implicated in rheumatoid arthritis progression.

title: Case report: unrelated topic
abstract: This paper discusses general trends in hospital administration efficiency across three regional healthcare networks.
